name: Checkin - BACKUP
query:
SELECT
    emp.employee_number AS "Employee ID", 
    emp.employee_name AS "Employee Name", 
    emp.custom_office AS "Office", 
    emp.custom_category AS "Category",
    emp.custom_employment_status AS "Employment Status",
    emp.status AS "Status", 
    CASE
        WHEN checkin.custom_is_break = 1 AND checkin.log_type = 'IN' THEN 'BREAK IN'
        WHEN checkin.custom_is_break = 0 AND checkin.log_type = 'IN' THEN 'IN'
        WHEN checkin.custom_is_break = 1 AND checkin.log_type = 'OUT' THEN 'BREAK OUT'
        WHEN checkin.custom_is_break = 0 AND checkin.log_type = 'OUT' THEN 'OUT'
        ELSE 'NO RECORD'
    END AS "Check-in Type",
    checkin.time AS "Checkin-Time", 
    checkin.device_id AS "Device Location"
FROM 
    `tabEmployee Checkin` AS checkin
LEFT JOIN 
    `tabEmployee` AS emp
ON 
    emp.name = checkin.employee
ORDER BY
    emp.name, checkin.time  ASC;
